message: Command `wc -l /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/file/src/apprentice.c && grep -n "magic_check\|magic_compile\|apprentice" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/file/src/apprentice.c | head -40` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: The vulnerability is a heap-buffer-overflow READ in `magic_fuzzer_loaddb`. The fuzzer calls `magic_check` and `magic_compile` on the input file. Let me look at the `apprentice.c` file which handles magic database compilation/checking.
